set -euo pipefail
rm -rf /tmp/slopgate-audit-run_f36588675f3f/wave1-accepted
mkdir -p /tmp/slopgate-audit-run_f36588675f3f/wave1-accepted
git diff --binary > /tmp/slopgate-audit-run_f36588675f3f/wave1-accepted/tracked.patch
git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | tar -cf /tmp/slopgate-audit-run_f36588675f3f/wave1-accepted/untracked.tar -T -

sha256sum /tmp/slopgate-audit-run_f36588675f3f/wave1-accepted/tracked.patch /tmp/slopgate-audit-run_f36588675f3f/wave1-accepted/untracked.tar /tmp/slopgate-audit-run_f36588675f3f/wave1-accepted/status.txt
md5sum baselines.json
